alb.why: Layer-7 load balancer spreading login traffic across zones.

waf.label: WAF 3.0
waf.why: Blocks CC floods, SQL injection and bot abuse at the ALB.

login.label: Login API servers
login.why: Runs the game login service in two zones for HA.

cache.label: Session cache
cache.why: Stores session tokens so logins are fast and stateless.

db.label: Accounts DB
db.why: Durable store for player credentials and profiles.

logs.label: Logs
logs.why: Centralizes access and security logs for forensics.

monitor.label: CloudMonitor
monitor.why: Alarms on CPU, latency and attack metrics.

assumptions.text: Web or mobile game login API over HTTPS

questions.text: Is the login API pure HTTPS, or do you also need raw TCP/UDP protection for the game server itself?
Where are most of your players located?
